text: Cornerstone delivered our 12-story office tower three weeks ahead of schedule and under budget. Their project management was flawless, and the quality of the finished building exceeded every expectation we had.

We've worked with many contractors over the years, but Cornerstone is in a class of their own. Transparent communication, meticulous craftsmanship, and a crew that genuinely cares about the work they do.
Building a medical facility comes with strict regulatory requirements. Cornerstone navigated every inspection and compliance hurdle without a single delay. Truly professional from start to finish.

Our 180-unit residential community was completed with remarkable attention to detail. The team treated our project like it was their own, and the results speak for themselves — fully leased within 90 days.
From the initial estimate to the final walkthrough, Cornerstone was honest and accountable. The warehouse they built for us has performed flawlessly for years with virtually no maintenance issues.
Renovating an active shopping center while keeping tenants open is no small feat. Cornerstone managed the phasing masterfully and kept disruption to an absolute minimum. Highly recommended.
